channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Has Pakistan reopened its border with Iran for trade?
item.description: Traders say some exports are crossing border after a weeklong halt, but Tehran says its cargo is not getting through.

item.title: Intercepted Houthi missiles cause damage in Saudi Arabian city
item.description: Debris fell on the Saudi city of Khamis Mushait after Houthi-fired missiles were intercepted.

item.title: Israeli forces kill at least five people in Gaza, including 7-year-old girl
item.description: The death toll in Israel's genocidal war on Gaza climbs to 74,555, including 1,559 killed since 'ceasefire' last year.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it struck Houthi missile facilities
item.description: Coalition says it destroyed ballistic missile launchers as well as tunnels and a depot used to store missiles.

item.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
item.description: Local youths reportedly accused the health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading Ebola.

item.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
item.description: After three years of regional war, this is a battle Israel always knew was coming, writes Lucy Williamson.

item.title: Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history
item.description: Security and democracy emerge as central issues in Israel's highly anticipated general election, as Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports.
